svg.title: UML Diagram: Class LogicalRecord in Context

g.text: UML Diagram: Class LogicalRecord in Context

a.title: • Identifier: Identifier for objects requiring short- or long-lasting referencing and management.
a.xlink:title: • Identifier: Identifier for objects requiring short- or long-lasting referencing and management.

a.title: • DataSet: Organized collection of data based on keys.
a.xlink:title: • DataSet: Organized collection of data based on keys.

a.title: • Concept: Unit of thought differentiated by characteristics (from the Generic Statistical Information Model version 1.2: https://statswiki.unece.org/display/clickablegsim/Concept).
a.xlink:title: • Concept: Unit of thought differentiated by characteristics (from the Generic Statistical Information Model version 1.2: https://statswiki.unece.org/display/clickablegsim/Concept).

a.title: • PhysicalDataSet: Information needed for understanding the physical structure of data coming from a file or other source.
a.xlink:title: • PhysicalDataSet: Information needed for understanding the physical structure of data coming from a file or other source.

a.title: • LogicalRecordRelationship: Relationships between logical records within a logical record repository structure.
a.xlink:title: • LogicalRecordRelationship: Relationships between logical records within a logical record repository structure.

a.title: • InstanceVariable: Use of a represented variable within a data set.
a.xlink:title: • InstanceVariable: Use of a represented variable within a data set.

a.title: • Segment: Description of each storage segment required to completely cover a physical data set.
a.xlink:title: • Segment: Description of each storage segment required to completely cover a physical data set.

a.title: • Collection: Generic container that supports different types of groupings, from unordered sets to all sorts of hierarchies, nesting and ordered sets/bags.
a.xlink:title: • Collection: Generic container that supports different types of groupings, from unordered sets to all sorts of hierarchies, nesting and ordered sets/bags.

a.title: • isDefinedBy: The conceptual basis for the collection of members.
a.xlink:title: • isDefinedBy: The conceptual basis for the collection of members.

a.title: • hasTarget: Note that this can be realized as a collection to support tuples.
a.xlink:title: • hasTarget: Note that this can be realized as a collection to support tuples.
